sources.title: XlPieSliceIndex enumeration
facts: Index3 is outer clockwise; index4 is mid clockwise radius; index2 is outer center.
Index8 is the inner center of a doughnut slice. Index5 is not used to assume the source radial midpoint.

sources.title: PowerPoint Point.PieSliceLocation
facts: Returns native coordinates in points relative to chart area.
Documented applicability is pie; doughnut API availability remains unqualified.

sources.title: XlPieSliceLocation enumeration
facts: Location1 is horizontal X; location2 is vertical Y.

inference: From documented native radius midpoint M4 and outer endpoint O3, infer C=M4+(M4-O3). This is independently measured native geometry, not a serialized OPF overlay/plot estimate. Source center is midpoint C+outer2 for pie or inner8+outer2 for doughnut.
